C1830.title: Changzhou, Jiangsu: Company J Cracked Xiaohongshu App's Encrypted Interface to Bypass Client and Send Direct Messages
keywords: illegal crawling of computer information systems
C1830.summary: From June 2019 to December 2021, Company J controlled by Chen developed an AI interaction platform that cracked the encrypted data interface between Xiaohongshu's App client and server, forged data requests to intrude on the server, and illegally crawled user nicknames, userID, noteID, notes and other data; it then cracked the App's private-message interface so that paying merchants could bypass Xiaohongshu's official client messaging system and send ad direct messages to App users, with cumulative illegal proceeds exceeding 6.5 million yuan. In 2024, the Tianning District Court in Changzhou sentenced Company J to a 200,000 yuan fine for illegally obtaining and controlling computer information system data, and sentenced Chen and five others to prison terms from three years to one year and nine months with probation of five to two years, each with fines.
